description: Roads - Block Character 2025 is a dataset listed in City of Salinas Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Derived from NearMap aerial imagery. A letter, word, or numeric message on a roadway providing navigation instruction. Includes Faded or damaged character symbols Characters that can be identified as text or numbers, even if the exact word or number cannot be identified Character symbol pavement markings in any colour eg. Coverage: Salinas, California. The portal files it under City Infrastructure, Imagery-Derived Data. Its keywords are road markings, street markings. The portal shows 5,455 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-03-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cityofsalinas-portal.
